items.briefing:
Be cautious of unexpected calendar invites arriving in your inbox. Barracuda has warned that cybercriminals are using .ics calendar files as a phishing method — clicking these can lead to credential theft or malware. This technique is concerning because calendar invites often appear routine and trustworthy, making them easy to overlook.

On a broader note, a Canadian man has pleaded guilty to extortion charges linked to the Snowflake data breach, a reminder that cloud platform compromises have real consequences. **Practical tip:** If you receive an unsolicited calendar invite, especially from an unknown sender, decline and delete it without clicking any links inside.
